fields.title: 8. Corrections and Resolutions from the Previous Issue
fields.md:
- **No corrections** — the figures and verdicts of Issue 6 (Ukraine) stand as they are (source: `reports/2026-10-27-event-r2.md`).
- **Resolved (partial)**: the open item "Amazon Leo Vulcan LV-01 (10/29 target, 40 satellites) result and pricing" → LV-01 has **slipped to November** (LL2), and pricing **remains unannounced**. The rest (official Starlink US residential pricing) remains unresolved (source: Section 6).
- **Still unresolved**: 10-Q Item 1A risk factors · Ukraine follow-up (T7) · GPU lease fixed rate · original source of 'CDS 197.6bp' · full text of FCC DA 26-553 (source: `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).
- **New open items**: ① the news watcher's D2D event → T4 link (loose classification, the measurement layer's responsibility) ② because FCC ICFS and EDOCS are not sources for the measurement layer, SpaceX's own FCC grant (10/6) went unrecorded for 3 weeks — the measurement layer's responsibility ③ the order number and date of the C-3 grant (confirmed only through press reports) ④ the latter part of the full text of DA 26-1078 (this issue's tool read up to 100,000 of 116,000 characters — anything after Condition 17 was not reviewed) (source: Sections 2 and 3).
